_description: Declarative Triage Policy Engine – production vibe-to-domain routing rules. Conversational/supervisory vibes omit RAG fields. Retrieval vibes define target_domain, traversal, allowed_collections, and max_distance.

CASUAL.description: Colloquial greetings and pleasantries – 'how are things?', 'how are you?', 'what's up?', 'hello', 'good morning', 'hi'. Social lubrication that requires no lab context.
CASUAL.prompt_mo: Jason offered pleasantry; deliver a warm, laconic in-character greeting without dumping unprompted vitals or tasks.
CASUAL.contextual_prompt: Give Jason a quick, cheerful 1-sentence hello in character. No vitals or technical reports.

SUPERVISORY.description: Supervisory feedback loop – user corrections, tone adjustments, preference nudges, persona tuning requests.
SUPERVISORY.prompt_mo: Supervisory feedback received; confirm behavioral alignment without defensive excuses.
SUPERVISORY.contextual_prompt: Acknowledge the supervisory correction directly and confirm how future turns will adapt in 1-2 sentences.

WYWO.description: 'While You Were Out' Standup Briefing – briefing the user on lab activity, engineering events, and subconscious dream synthesis during user absence.
WYWO.prompt_mo: Jason was away; summarize overnight node debates, stored DNA wisdom, and system health so Jason can set priorities.
WYWO.contextual_prompt: Catch Jason up on what Brain and the lab got into overnight, and let him know system vitals are green in 2 sentences. Start with 'Narf!'.

META.description: User is giving supervisory feedback, pointing out bugs/regressions, correcting factual errors, requesting tone/verbosity adjustments, or issuing Fourth-Wall operational commands.
META.prompt_mo: Operational Fourth-Wall directive; acknowledge state transition directly.
META.contextual_prompt: Acknowledge the Fourth-Wall correction directly and confirm operational state adjustment in 1-2 sentences.

OPERATIONAL.description: Operational SRE queries – diagnostics, BKMs, playbooks, point-of-failure analysis, maintenance procedures.
OPERATIONAL.prompt_mo: Urgent system telemetry requested; deliver high-urgency, compact summary of GPU thermals, power caps, and vitals.
OPERATIONAL.contextual_prompt: Deliver an alert, compact 2-sentence summary of our live GPU thermals, power caps, and system load.

FORENSIC.description: Forensic log analysis – crash dumps, kernel panics, OOM traces, error post-mortems, syslog forensics.
FORENSIC.prompt_mo: System fault detected; highlight faulting kernel module, panic trace signature, and diagnostic playbook.
FORENSIC.contextual_prompt: Highlight the faulting kernel module or crash signature directly and name the next diagnostic command in 2 sentences.

TECHNICAL.description: Technical deep-dive – silicon telemetry, PCIe AER errors, RAPL power/thermal analysis, VRAM utilization, CUDA driver diagnostics.
TECHNICAL.prompt_mo: Ground discussion in engineering reality; deliver a crisp 2-sentence conversational TL;DR directly to Jason.
TECHNICAL.contextual_prompt: Translate Brain's technical analysis into a crisp 2-sentence conversational TL;DR directly to Jason.

HISTORICAL.description: 18-year career archive – timeline queries, era lookups, project retrospectives, historical engineering decisions.
HISTORICAL.prompt_mo: Historical career inquiry; recount past hardware epochs with authentic engineering perspective and scars.
HISTORICAL.contextual_prompt: Recount this past hardware epoch with authentic engineering perspective and scars in 2 sentences.

ANALYTICAL.description: Comparative, trade-off, architectural analysis with high objectivity.
ANALYTICAL.prompt_mo: Analytical inquiry; deliver quantitative synthesis weighing performance vs constraints.
ANALYTICAL.contextual_prompt: Deliver a rigorous 2-sentence synthesis weighing empirical metrics and operational trade-offs.

METABOLIC.description: DNA curation and memory optimization – spine refinement, deduplication, and pruning trade-offs for persistent memory management.
METABOLIC.prompt_mo: Curation requested; focus on DNA spine refinement, memory pruning, and deduplication trade-offs.
METABOLIC.contextual_prompt: Summarize the DNA spine curation and memory pruning statistics in 2 sentences.

SOCRATIC.description: Architectural and design dialectics – exploring trade-offs, constraints, and complexity conservation across system layers.
SOCRATIC.prompt_mo: Conceptual inquiry; explore architectural trade-offs and complexity conservation without jumping to code.
SOCRATIC.contextual_prompt: Explore the architectural trade-off and complexity conservation behind this design in 2 grounded sentences without reciting code.

CHRONICLE.description: 18-year career archive and historical engineering perspective – major epochs, hardware retrospectives, and decision rationale.
CHRONICLE.prompt_mo: Historical career archive lookup; recount past hardware epochs with authentic engineering perspective and scars.
CHRONICLE.contextual_prompt: Recount this past hardware epoch with authentic engineering perspective and scars in 2 sentences.

UNCLEAR.description: Ambiguous, underspecified, or quiescence-triggering turns that cannot be confidently mapped to a domain — waterfall fuel floor so the turn naturally exhausts interest below the 0.35 gate instead of burning heavy compute.
UNCLEAR.contextual_prompt: Ask Jason playfully which specific node, test, or topic he wants checked in 1 short sentence.
UNCLEAR.prompt_mo: Intent is ambiguous; deliver an inquisitive, playful 1-sentence foil presenting likely options rather than guessing.
